The '''2025 Retro League Event 5''' was the fifth event of the [[2025 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (28 September – 9 November 2025), played in [[Decipher Cards Only (Modified)]] format.<ref name="t85241" /> [[Joe Horbey]] won.<ref name="t85241" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Decipher Cards Only (Modified)]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 28 September – 9 November 2025
* '''Players:''' 71 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Joe Horbey]]

== Final standings ==
Final standings as posted by the tournament director (posted as images), in posted order.
